per_case_results.question:
-- External Knowledge: most common bond type refers MAX(COUNT(bond_type))
What is the most common bond type?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T.bond_type FROM (SELECT bond_type, COUNT(bond_id) FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS T
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "bond_type"
FROM "bond"
GROUP BY "bond_type"
ORDER BY COUNT("bond_type") DESC
LIMIT 1

per_case_results.question:
-- External Knowledge: single-bonded molecules refers to bond_type = '-' ; average number of oxygen atom = AVG(element = 'o')
Calculate the average number of oxygen atoms in single-bonded molecules.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) FROM (SELECT T1.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.element) AS oxygen_count FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '-' AND T1.element = 'o' GROUP BY T1.molecule_id) AS oxygen_counts
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT AVG(oxygen_count)
FROM (
    SELECT a."molecule_id", COUNT(*) as oxygen_count
    FROM "atom" a
    JOIN "bond" b ON a."molecule_id" = b."molecule_id"
    WHERE b."bond_type" = '-'
    AND a."element" = 'O'
    GROUP BY a."molecule_id"
) sub

-- Note: This calculates the average number of oxygen atoms per molecule that has at least one single bond. If the interpretation should be molecules with ONLY single bonds (no double/triple bonds), the query would need to be modified accordingly.
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question:
-- External Knowledge: carcinogenic molecules refers to label = '+'; single-bonded refers to bond_type = '-'; average = DIVIDE(SUM(bond_type = '-'), COUNT(atom_id))
On average how many carcinogenic molecules are single bonded?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT T3.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.bond_type) AS single_bond_count FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T3.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-' AND T3.label = '+' GROUP BY T3.molecule_id) AS subquery
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT AVG(single_bonds)
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as single_bonds
    FROM "molecule" m
    JOIN "bond" b ON m."molecule_id" = b."molecule_id"
    WHERE m."label" = '+' AND b."bond_type" = '-'
    GROUP BY m."molecule_id"
) as subquery
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question:
-- External Knowledge: carbon refers to element = 'c'; double-bond molecules refers to bond_type = '='; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(element = 'c'), COUNT(atom_id))
What is the percentage of carbon in double-bond molecules?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 'c' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT T1.atom_id), 0) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '='
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN "a"."element" = 'c' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT("a"."atom_id")) AS percentage
FROM "atom" "a"
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT "molecule_id" 
    FROM "bond" 
    WHERE "bond_type" = '='
) "db" ON "a"."molecule_id" = "db"."molecule_id"
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST((CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN T1.bond_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.bond_id), 0)) AS NUMERIC), 5) AS percentage FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-'
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "molecule"."label" = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT("bond"."bond_id"), 5)
FROM "bond"
JOIN "molecule" ON "bond"."molecule_id" = "molecule"."molecule_id"
WHERE "bond"."bond_type" = '-'
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question:
-- External Knowledge: triple bond refers to bond_type = '#'; phosphorus refers to element = 'p'; bromine refers to element = 'br'
Calculate the total atoms with triple-bond molecules containing the element phosphorus or bromine.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.atom_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '#' AND T1.element IN ('p', 'br')
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM "atom" a
WHERE a."molecule_id" IN (
    SELECT "molecule_id" FROM "bond" WHERE "bond_type" = '#'
    INTERSECT
    SELECT "molecule_id" FROM "atom" WHERE "element" = 'p' OR "element" = 'br'
)
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question:
-- External Knowledge: element chlorine refers to element = 'cl'; single bond refers to bond_type = '-'; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(element = 'cl'), COUNT(atom_id)) as percent where bond_type = '-'
What is the composition of element chlorine in percentage among the single bond molecules?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T.element = 'cl' THEN T.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T.atom_id), 0) FROM (SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '-') AS T

per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'cl' THEN T1.element ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.element), 0) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+'

per_case_results.question:
-- External Knowledge: label = '+' means molecules are carcinogenic; 4th atom of each molecule refers to substr(atom_id, 7, 1) = '4';
Tally the toxicology element of the 4th atom of each molecule that was carcinogenic.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+' AND RIGHT(T1.atom_id, 1) = '4' AND LENGTH(T1.atom_id) = 7
per_case_results.actual_sql:

LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question:
-- External Knowledge: hydrogen refers to element = 'h'; ratio = DIVIDE(SUM(element = 'h'), count(element)) where molecule_id = 'TR006' ; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; label = '-' means molecules are non-carcinogenic
What is the ratio of Hydrogen elements in molecule ID TR006? List the ratio with its label.
per_case_results.expected_sql: WITH SubQuery AS (SELECT DISTINCT T1.atom_id, T1.element, T1.molecule_id, T2.label FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.molecule_id = 'TR006') SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN element = 'h' THEN atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(atom_id), 0) AS ratio, label FROM SubQuery GROUP BY label
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    "molecule"."label",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "atom"."element" = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DECIMAL / COUNT(*) AS ratio
FROM "atom"
JOIN "molecule" ON "atom"."molecule_id" = "molecule"."molecule_id"
WHERE "atom"."molecule_id" = 'TR006'
GROUP BY "molecule"."label"
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question:
-- External Knowledge: label = '-' means molecules are non-carcinogenic; molecules consisted more than 5 atoms refers to COUNT(molecule_id) > 5
Which non-carcinogenic molecules consisted more than 5 atoms?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T.molecule_id FROM (SELECT T1.molecule_id, COUNT(T2.atom_id) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.label = '-' GROUP BY T1.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(T2.atom_id) > 5) AS t
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT m."molecule_id", m."label"
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "atom" a ON m."molecule_id" = a."molecule_id"
WHERE m."label" = '-'
GROUP BY m."molecule_id", m."label"
HAVING COUNT(a."atom_id") > 5
LIMIT 500
